evals.prompt: Render volumetric clouds by marching the full camera ray for every pixel, sampling detail noise even in empty space, moving density in camera UV coordinates, rebuilding maximum-resolution 3D textures for every weather change, preserving temporal history through cuts, and enabling the same tier on mobile.
evals.expected_output: A staged weather, density, lighting, shadow and temporal cloud system with bounded volumes, empty-space skipping, world-stable motion, valid history rejection, measured stage and memory budgets, scalable quality modes, and low-end fallbacks.
assertions: Cloud layers, coverage, type, weather map, wind, density profile, lighting, shadow receivers, camera envelope, backend, and performance tiers are declared.
Low-frequency shape and vertical profile precede detail erosion while raymarching is restricted to analytic cloud bounds with empty-space skipping and early termination.
Cloud and weather motion stay in world or weather coordinates and lighting, ambient, multi-scatter approximation, and cloud shadows are introduced as measurable stages.
Temporal reconstruction rejects invalid history after cuts, teleports, entry, weather changes, incompatible parameters, or resolution changes.
Horizon, cloud entry, sunrise, sunset, transitions, density and lighting diagnostics, GPU time by stage, texture memory, quality tiers, and billboard or disabled fallback are verified.
